title: Descriptor-guided guarded back edge
summary: Executes a compiler-matched scalar body and condition through either loop exit or a scalar continuation and back edge.
premises: An exact generated equality for the selected instruction interval
Compiler-derived body and condition evaluator equations
An exit postcondition and a continuing-statement transition
result: A weakest-precondition result that returns Break 1 after a true condition or executes the continuing descriptor and returns Break 0 after a false condition.
